prompt:
The visual shows a close-packed bubble-shooter board with colored bubbles, a marked landing target, and a visible launcher area. A shot bubble attaches at the marked target. A same-color connected group pops when the placed bubble makes that group size at least three. Do not count the shot bubble or the marked target itself. Count the existing board bubbles that pop when the shown shot lands at the marked target.
Final answer format: set "answer" to the number of existing board bubbles that pop.
Annotation format: set "annotation" to an array of pixel-space center points [x, y] for the existing board bubbles that pop.
Example JSON:
{"annotation":[[373,237],[419,237],[396,277],[442,277],[488,277]],"answer":5}
